summary: Latah County, ID crow's nest from the 1930s, listed under the Potlatch Timber Protective Association; sources call it abandoned and say it was still there in the 1980s.

facts.status_note: Sources call it abandoned and say the crow's nest was still there in the 1980s; no source read says it was removed

access.note: No access information in the sources read

events.note: Crow's nest, dated only to the 1930s

evidence.supports: PTPA named in full; Latah County
crow's nest from the 1930s, still there in the 1980s, abandoned
the name Kresek listed beside the crow's nest
Idaho Fire Lookouts lists a crow's nest at the site
firelookout.org index: Latah County, coordinates, abandoned

corrections.why: Sources call the crow's nest abandoned and say it was still there in the 1980s; none of the sources read says it was removed

notes_for_editor: Brief record says gone; the four sources say abandoned and still there in the 1980s, and none says it was removed, so status is corrected to unknown. Brief's elevation 1139 m is not in any source read and is not used. Kresek is named beside the crow's nest on Forest Lookouts with no explanation. Do not confuse with the separate Rocky Point records for Clearwater NF and Payette NF, which are different lookouts.
